title: Você
summary: The Você tab (ADR 0112): who you are first, then the settings groups. A profile row (photo, name, @), the trust card, Anotações, Meus agendamentos, Convidar pessoas, settings-root, then Adicionar conta.

accounts.description: Accounts on this phone. The switcher section shows only when there are two or more.

isCompany.description: Company account from the Bipe API, independent of its verification badge. Selects the rounded-square avatar.

openProfile.effect: Opens Seu perfil (settings-group profile). A tap anywhere on the profile row.

openQr.effect: Opens profile-link with the QR code shown (bipe_profile_qr_title). From the QR code button in the navigation bar. Share and copy live on that screen.

openInvites.effect: Opens the invites screen (a later spec).

openTrust.effect: Opens trust-profile from the trust card (spec trust-card).

addAccount.effect: Opens account-new (bipe_app_account_new). The last row of Você, after settings-root.

notes: MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#577): Você has no account rows. The accounts on this phone switch from the Você tab: a hold opens account-switcher, a double tap goes to the next account, and screen readers use the tab's accessibility action (app-tabs). MZ, 2 Nov 2026 (bipe-chat/bipe#988): Adicionar conta (bipe_app_account_new) is the last row of Você, after settings-root, as plain accent text without a tile, as Instagram's add-account row next to sign-out. Adding an account is rare, so it does not take the place under the header.
MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#577): the header shows the current account's avatar (photo, else initials). Since the chat list has no account avatar, Você is the one screen that shows it.
Asks (MZ, 2 Nov 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#894): Você shows no prompt cards. The photo and osTheftProtection asks are entries of chat-list-prompt, the one ask system of the app.
The header never shows the Matrix ID (ADR 0112).
The trust card (Perfil de confiança, ADR 0019) sits right after the profile row: spec trust-card, which opens trust-profile.
Below Convidar pessoas comes settings-root (Configurações). Adicionar conta follows it.

The header and account rows load the actual Matrix avatar through the SDK media API. Without a photo use initials. Shape follows ADR 0132: company is a rounded square; personal/unknown is a circle. A profile name or CNPJ badge must not determine account type.

Profile row (MZ, 2 Nov 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#988; iPhone Settings, WhatsApp and Signal layout): one full-width row at the top of the list, with the 60 pt avatar, the display name (headline), the @ (bipe secondary ink) and a chevron. A tap anywhere on the row opens Seu perfil; its accessibility hint is bipe_settings_profile. There is no centred hero, no text link and no bordered buttons. The QR code button (Phosphor qr-code, accessibility label bipe_profile_qr_action) sits at the trailing end of the navigation bar; a company account has it too.

Order above Configurações (bipe-chat/bipe#988): profile row; trust card; a section with Anotações and Meus agendamentos, personal accounts only (what you use); a section with Convidar pessoas. The year recap is not on Você (MZ, 3 Nov 2026): it is the last row of Conversas e mídia (settings-group chats). These rows use the same icon tile as settings-root.
A personal account has a Meus agendamentos row (bipe_agenda_my_bookings) after Anotações; it opens agenda-my-bookings. A booking list is not a setting.

The link-phone flow (link-phone-show) is not on Você since bipe-chat/bipe#988: its row bipe_app_link_phone_action (Trocar de celular) is the first row of Sua conta > Aparelhos (settings-group account). Conectar outro aparelho next to Aparelhos conectados read as the same thing.
